question: The power of an electric bulb in which a current of 2 amp flows when it is connected to a 220 V generator is _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**440 watt**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Power (P):** Measured in Watts (W), power is the rate at which electrical energy is transferred or used.
 
• **Voltage (V):** Measured in Volts (V), voltage is the electrical potential difference that drives the current through a circuit.
 
• **Current (I):** Measured in Amperes (A), current is the flow of electric charge through a circuit.

The relationship between these three is given by the formula:

P = V × I

**Calculation**

 
• 
 
**Given Values:**

 
 
• Voltage (V) = 220 V
 
• Current (I) = 2 A
 
 
 
• 
 
**Applying the Formula:**

 
 
• Power (P) = V × I
 
• P = 220 V × 2 A
 
• P = 440 W
 
 

**Therefore, the power of the electric bulb is 440 Watts.**
